thread:
maria: Hey folks — noticed a regression on the console dashboards after last night's telemetry rewrite. Heatmap and multi-series charts are stalling on first hover and initial paint. Happened around the canary rollout. Anyone else seeing this?

sam: Yup, repro'd locally. First interaction freeze ~400-800ms, main thread CPU spike. Looks like bundle size increased and there's a sync init path.

lee: How do you repro? Which dashboard/route?

maria: Steps: 1) open /dashboards/usage (eu) 2) click heatmap legend to toggle series 3) observe main-thread block and chart freeze. Attached a console profile snippet.

deploy-bot: deploy: canary telemetry-v2 -> eu succeeded (1699998900) :white_check_mark:

alex: Profile shows long time spent in window.__REDWOOD_TELEMETRY.init => ~120-200ms parse+execute before any render handlers run. Suspect telemetry bundle pulled into core bundle due to static import in analytics.ts.

nora: We debated lazy-loading telemetry during the rollout notes. If it's in the core bundle now, that would explain the parse hit. Could we defer init until after firstPaint?

sam: Quick check: analytics.ts does `import "./telemetry"` at module top-level. Switching to `import('./telemetry').then(m=>m.init())` should move it to a split chunk. I can try a tiny patch.

lee: I'll try a canary build with dynamic import + setTimeout 0 to yield to the main thread, see if hover stutters go away.

maria: FYI metrics: avg interaction-blocking >50ms went from 12% -> 28% on canary users. LCP median bumped ~300ms on heavy dashboards. Not huge but noticeable.

sam: Also saw accidental sync sourcemap processing in telemetry error handler — `readSourceMapSync()` in dev util accidentally shipped. If that's being executed, parse cost + I/O could be worse. Will audit.

alex: Good catch. Even if we lazy-load, we should remove sync sourcemap extraction or gate it behind `if (env === 'dev')`.

nora: Long-term, split telemetry into a lightweight shim (logging handshake) in core and move heavy collectors offline/later. For now though, hotfix via dynamic import + remove sync call should mitigate.

maria: Plan: sam will open PR with dynamic import + removal of sync sourcemap call. Deploy to 30% canary, measure main-thread blocking and hover latency. If numbers improve, roll to 100%. If not, fallback to rendering placeholders and batching series toggles.

sam: On it — opening PR now. https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/4823 (WIP). Will include metrics and revert notes.

deploy-bot: canary deploy: pr-4823 -> eu 30% at 1699998999

nora: Please add ENG-4930 to the PR body and a revert checklist.

maria: Thanks. Lee, once canary is up can you run the quick repro and drop profile? If hover freeze gone we can close this fast.

lee: Will do in 10m and paste profile here.

alex: Also add a short note in the rollout doc — telemetry-v2 caused bundle inclusion change, mention lazy-load next time.

maria: Great, thanks everyone :thumbsup:
